title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Bed-Hold Days inside a Re-Charge Span
content:
**Leave billing note, resumed months — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** Days away on a resident-private bed hold are charged under the resident's **Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations** reservation and come off the re-charge span as its re-charge leave days.

| Bed-hold records | Re-charge leave days |
|---|---|
| The latest booking of resident-private bed-hold days (the one whose first booked day is latest; the one posted first where two share that day) starts on or after the conversion date recorded on the agreement and on or before the last day of the advance's span | Those booked days less the days reversed against that booking, the remaining days counted in a row from the first booked day |
| No such booking starts there, and a private bed hold of the resident is in force with its first privately paid day on or after that conversion date | The days held so far, from that first day through the day before the span is worked out |
| Neither | None |

Only the leave days falling on or after the first re-charged day and on or before the last re-charge day come off the span.

**Hypothetical case.** Re-charge days run from day 9 to day 30 of a span. No resident-private booking starts on or after the conversion date, but a private bed hold in force began on day 24 and the span is worked out on day 28: days 24 to 27, 4 leave days, all inside the re-charge days.
